assets.subject: Three chairs at a long red-clothed table, central high-backed chair empty, single desk lamp.
Thick dossier tied with string, rimless glasses lying on it, soldier's shadow falling across.
Three newspaper columns pinned side by side on board, only grey lines without letters, red pin on one.
Steep red arrow graph spiralling upward into a whirl.
Tractor ploughing endless steppe beneath huge sky, tent and red pennant behind.
Giant ear of corn robed like queen, standing in snowfield with small polar station behind.
Shining white tower of future rising out of scaffolding, red banner on top, fireworks.
Classroom blackboard with two opposing chalk arrows, one deep one curved defensive, pointer stick.
Tanks and pegasus paratroopers flowing through breach in barbed wire, red arrows on ground.
Cinema screen showing tanks in silhouette, audience of ponies in front, projector beam.
Soldier pony planting flag in frozen river bank, burning city skyline behind.
Thin grey book on staff map with compasses and coloured pencils, lamp.
Worker pony in flat cap with rifle and red armband, factory chimneys behind.
Factory gate with crowd of worker ponies raising hooves in vote.
Vast congress hall seen from back, thousands of raised voting cards.
Many small red flags on poles forming ring around larger flag.
Shield made of logs and concrete set into snow, rifle slit glowing.
Cinema hall in daylight with lights suddenly on, militia pony at door.
Fluffy white cotton boll with gold coin hidden inside.
Iron gauntlet-shaped HORSESHOE gripping red star, no hand or fingers.
White-columned palace of pioneers with fountain, red neckerchief on gate.
Overflowing cornucopia of bread apples and gears pouring out of glowing computer, red banner above.
Delicatessen counter with hidden back-room door ajar, tin of caviar glowing.
Detective's leather coat and wide-brim hat on hook, pistol holster beside.
Seven armchairs in semicircle facing glowing wall screens with charts without numbers.
Market stall with red awning, crates of apples and bread, golden coin with horseshoe.
Grand old palace wrapped in scaffolding, heavy door swinging open with warm light pouring out.
Wooden abacus over factory ledger with rising golden arrow, gear behind.
Big stopwatch without numbers with red star, militia cap resting against it.
Many raised hooves holding red voting cards, big red banner rising above, politically neutral.
Massive armoured door set in snowy mountainside, factory light spilling from gap, pines.
Colossal blast furnace and factory chimneys above tiny steppe settlement, red glow from furnace mouth.
Tents and bonfire on seashore under mountains, bugle hanging on pole.
Unicorn horn shooting blue sparks into glowing purple crystals wired into computer.
Factory chimney rising out of glowing network of lines and nodes, red star on top.
Red book with military star on cover, radar dish rising behind.
Big red switch lever, half background bright and open, half dark with watching eye.
Glowing map of North covered with computing centres joined by bright network lines, red star at centre node.
Huge glowing eye made of computer lights over city of identical blocks, searchlights.
Rounded 1960s refrigerator with small embossed pentagon quality mark on door, no letters.
Globe-shaped lectern draped red banner, three small flags with pony griffon feather zebra stripe motifs.
Landing ship bow ramp dropping onto foreign palm-lined beach, red pennant on mast.
Plain clock face without numerals, both hands almost at top, faint mushroom cloud behind.
Globe with three continents glowing red, red star orbiting like satellite.
One large red banner surrounded by five smaller red banners on poles in fan arrangement.
Long missile under canvas tarpaulin on cargo ship deck at night, spray.
Railway cutting straight through dense taiga toward low mountains, tent and red flag beside rails.
Dark suit jacket chest completely covered with medals and five golden hero stars.
Flaming torch whose fire spirals upward in endless red helix.
Blazing red north star over snowy mountain peaks.
Front of 1920s armoured train with red star on boiler, steam and searchlight.
Open book and oil lantern inside small reed hut by marsh.
Sealed envelope with large red wax seal bearing horseshoe.
Single glowing light bulb hanging from wire above wooden village cottage.
Heavy door swinging open, warm daylight pouring into dark office.
White dove perched on missile cut in half.
Megaphone with newspapers flying out, no readable text.
Golden sun and red star intertwined above signed treaty with several wax seals, no letters.
Stack of small red party membership booklets without text beside a fountain pen.
Peaked officer's cap resting on closed map case, rifle leaning against it, back turned to red flag.
Rows of telephones on office desk, all receivers on hooks, one light still burning.
Barred prison gate half open, warm daylight and birch tree outside.
Two locomotives racing side by side on parallel rails, nearer one with red star pulling ahead.
Stylised continent map silhouette entirely in red, north star above.
Butcher's hook with ribbon-decorated hero star hanging on it, empty cattle stall behind.
Parachute gently lowering a factory chimney onto a field.
Red pencil crossing out soaring graph line and drawing lower honest one.
Tractor turning into tank, half wheels and half tracks, factory floor.
Massed pony infantry assault with fixed bayonets behind creeping artillery barrage.
Pegasus soldiers in leather helmets diving in formation from transport plane.
Row of heavy howitzers firing at night, muzzle flashes lighting snow.
Concrete pillbox under snow with camouflage net, pine forest behind.
Worker ponies in factory hall pushing repaired tank toward open gate, sparks.
Many trench lines stacked behind one another to horizon, aerial view.
Partisan pony in fur hat with rifle among birch trees, railway explosion in distance.
Log village hall with red flag and blank notice board, horses' carts outside.
Patrol ship launching down slipway into icy water, cranes around.
Small agile fighter plane banking sharply, hawk silhouette in shadow.
Gold coin embossed with horseshoe and star, no numbers, stacked on ledger.
Hand printing press with fresh sheets, grey lines only, hanging to dry.
Wide open double doors of council hall with ponies streaming in.
Wooden blank nameplate holder on desk turning like revolving door.
Soldier ponies in greatcoats raising rifles to vote around officer pony.
Stopwatch hanging over factory conveyor belt, no numbers.
Column of pony militia in mismatched coats marching with red banner.
Ponies carrying log together in spring yard, red banner on fence.
Wooden honour board with rows of blank portrait frames and red star on top.
Typewriter under desk lamp with carbon copy sheet, dossier stamp without text.
Magnifying glass over warehouse ledger without text.
Radio mast spraying zigzag interference waves into night sky.
Barrier gate on forest road before secret town of white apartment blocks.
Foals in caps playing war game in forest, toy rifles and flag.
Cadet's black uniform cap with red band, white gloves laid beside.
